title: Bearish Engulfing Follow-Through
summary: Of the sessions whose red body engulfed the prior green session's body: a session-level bearish engulfing candle: how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is engulfing sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones followed by a green close, so a LOW estimate is what the pattern's usual story predicts. Rare patterns mean small N: the guards and intervals are part of the answer, not decoration.
deltas: the exact mirror of engulfing-bull, on one definition, so the asymmetry is measurable
minimum-N guards and CIs keep rare-pattern statistics honest
compose with trend or streak conditions to test the context the textbooks assume
